purpose: Single source of the shared inputs in the project flowchart. Both the Elmer geometry/water-field stage and the cell-interface stage read this file. Edit values here, not in the stage code.

steel.note: Wetted working-electrode (steel) face area. The planar Elmer fixture uses out-of-plane depth = exposed_area_m2 / electrode_width_m. The nominal value reproduces the validated 40 mm x 50 um fixture face. Larger areas raise current and can saturate the 1 Mohm TIA; Darshan's saturation check then rejects the run.

water.note: Declared bulk water conductivity. Not measured. Uniform and temperature-independent in the model.

electrode_geometry.note: Parallel planar WE and CE separated by the gap; non-loading RE point on the centreline at reference_distance_from_we_m. The supplied connected Elmer mesh is mapped affinely to these dimensions (topology and boundary IDs unchanged).

uncertainty_basis: independent rectangular engineering assumptions (half-widths above), not measured tolerances

cell_interface.calibration_file_note: Set mode to 'calibrated' and calibration_file to a JSON with Rp_ohm, Cdl_F, stern_geary_B_V and their *_standard_uncertainty values plus a 'source' string to replace the assumed values below.

assumed.source: EXPLICITLY ASSUMED. Rp is the simulated cell value of the validated fixture. Cdl = 40 uF/cm2 x steel area (upper end of the 10-40 uF/cm2 range for metal electrodes, Bard & Faulkner 2001). B = 26 mV for actively corroding steel follows Stern & Geary (1957) with Tafel slopes of 120 mV/decade, as used by Andrade & Alonso (2004); the range is a declared bound, not a measured Tafel result. See configs/PARAMETER_SOURCES.json.

corrosion_conversion.basis: ASTM G102 uniform-corrosion conversion for iron (Fe -> Fe2+). Applied only after ACCEPT.
conditions: uniform corrosion over the declared exposed area
Stern-Geary B as declared above (assumed unless calibrated)
Rp from the simulated cell, not from a physical specimen
